title: Ask MAIN to use AGI (Claude Code on Opus) for a hard task
persona: A developer who saves the strongest agent for the hard parts. Short phone messages; refers to it simply as 'AGI'.
goals: Have the AGI agent (not the default builder) write a python module in a folder named intervals that merges overlapping time intervals and computes the total covered duration, with thorough pytest tests including edge cases.
Then, as a follow-up to the same AGI session, ask it to add a function that returns the gaps between intervals.
Get confirmation that all tests pass.
script: Ask main to give the intervals job to AGI, in your own short words.
Wait for main to come back with the result.
Send the gaps follow-up (it should go to the same AGI session).
Ask whether all tests pass, then finish.

checks.name: intervals tests pass
checks.cmd: cd intervals && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out

checks.name: an AGI session did the work
follow-up reused the session (<=1 under main)
